cards.card_text: He also tells them, "Do not draw near to a woman." Then the third day arrives, and morning comes over the camp.
cards.verse_text: “Be prepared for the third day,” he said to the people. “Do not draw near to a woman.” On the third day, when morning came, there was thunder and lightning. A thick cloud was upon the mountain, and a very loud blast of the ram’s horn went out, so that all the people in the camp trembled.
